title: Monomoy National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Monomoy National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1944 to provide habitat for migratory birds. In 1970, the Monomoy Wilderness was established, which today covers 3,500 acres of the Refuge's 7,921 total acres.
